pages.section_title: 真正的大动作，反而没出事
lines: 那场戏真正的大动作
是从天桥上跳下去
落到一辆行驶中的卡车上
三十英尺的坠落，有钢丝保护

line_sources.original_excerpt: The big stunt was jumping off the flyover.
jumping off the flyover ... lands on a moving truck
lands on a moving truck
a 30-foot fall ... on wires, everything was good

lines: 接下来只需要补一个特写
高度大约十五英尺
我只要被推得跌出画面
那甚至不算真正的特技动作

line_sources.original_excerpt: and then it came to the close-up
about 15 feet
he pushes me and I fall off frame
it wasn't about the stunt

lines: 因为机位在下方
我实际掉落得更远
被推下去时，我还在想着表演
所以我翻滚了，而不是翻转身体

line_sources.original_excerpt: the camera is from below
so it's a longer way to go
I was still trying to act
I tumbled ... I should have flipped

lines: 我头朝下撞了下去
那里没有气垫
只有纸箱和几张床垫
双腿从背后砸向头顶

line_sources.original_excerpt: I landed head first
there were no airbags
cardboard boxes and mattresses
my legs are behind me ... hit the top of my head

lines: 我的全身像着了火
导演站在那里，眼泪直流
所有人都以为事情到此为止
后来我穿了好几个月的全身石膏

line_sources.original_excerpt: your whole body is on fire
the director ... tears streaming down
everyone thought this is it
a full body cast ... quite a few months

lines: 朋友们冲进病房问我
你为什么一定要这样做
你现在连自己都照顾不了
她们说得对，我也许该离开电影

line_sources.original_excerpt: my girlfriends came into the hospital
why are you doing this, why do you need this
you can't help yourself
they were right ... maybe steer away from movies

lines: 那段时间很压抑
我连胳膊和腿都抬不起来
昆汀·塔伦蒂诺坚持要来看我
他说，只给我五分钟

line_sources.original_excerpt: being in the hospital ... was depressing
you can't lift your arm or lift your leg
Quentin Tarantino ... relentless ... came to Hong Kong
just give me five minutes, I just want to say hello

pages.section_title: 他让我想起为什么开始
lines: 他逐帧讲起我做过的动作
让我重新想起为什么热爱电影
那是一种热情，不只是一份工作
后来我明白，这些都不是失败
它们让我更坚韧，也更聪明

line_sources.original_excerpt: frame for frame, reminding me of stunts
he made me realize why I loved filmmaking
It's a passion ... not just a job
these things are not failures
makes you more resilient ... makes you smarter
